# viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer L7 Policy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

data "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "by_name" {
  listener_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  name        = "redirect-to-https"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) L7 policy ID (UUID). Exactly one policy must match.
- `listener_id` (String) Listener ID (UUID) owning the L7 policy.
- `name` (String) Name of the L7 policy to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) L7 policy action.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 policy was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) L7 policy description.
- `position` (Number) Position of the L7 policy within the listener.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the L7 policy.
- `redirect_http_code` (Number) Redirect HTTP code.
- `redirect_prefix` (String) Redirect prefix.
- `redirect_server_group_id` (String) Redirect server group ID (UUID).
- `redirect_url` (String) Redirect URL.
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules associated with the L7 policy.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the L7 policy.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 policy was last updated (RFC3339).
